name: Knee-to-Wall Ankle Mobilization
steps: Face a wall in a half-kneeling or staggered standing stance with the toes of your front foot positioned a few inches away from the wall.
Keep your front heel pressed firmly into the floor and drive your front knee smoothly forward toward the wall over your middle toes.
Pause briefly when your knee touches the wall or reaches the end of its comfortable range, then glide back to the start.
Continue moving smoothly back and forth for the target duration on one ankle, then switch legs.
tips: Do not let your front heel lift off the floor as your knee travels forward.
Adjust your foot slightly closer to or farther from the wall so your knee just reaches it with a flat heel.
